enabled.description: Classify new and changed records into sensitivity tiers. Heuristic tiers also apply immediately whenever a restricted profile reads.

llmEnabled.description: Refine heuristic tiers with the chat model. Heuristics alone still classify everything.

maxSourcesPerRun.description: Maximum sources (with their entities and claims) sent to the model per run.

maxContentChars.description: Maximum source characters shown to the model per source.
